address: 6 quai Antoine-1er, Monaco, 98000, Principality of Monaco
bio: Hailing from the Bigorre region of South-West France, chef Sébastien Sanjou (Trente-Trois in Paris and Relais des Moines in Arcs-sur-Argens, both MICHELIN-starred establishments) has brought Marius – after its success in Biarritz – to Monaco. Changed up daily, the no-choice lunch menu immediately piques your interest and also represents good value for money. As for the appealing à la carte menu, it includes a tantalising array of Provençal and Monegasque classics: Jacques Maximin salad Niçoise, purple artichokes à la barigoule, aioli, stuffed squid braised Niçoise-style. Each dish is prepared using fresh ingredients and with real expertise. Relaxed bistro chic decor....
